Nina's dream job is to be a nurse. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Best of all, the country is the largest importer of coffee beans.

The corner store has become an important part of daily life. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Saturday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. We had a stimulating discussion after class.

Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Nina will take part in a table tennis match in February. Little by little, things began to change. I was mistaken about the time; the meeting starts at noon.

The pedestrian street looked quieter than usual that evening. Nina keeps a small bird at home and feeds it every morning. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. For example, shop around before you commit.
Nina thanked Grace for the honest advice. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
